title: The simple question

fixture.setup: config/dev-server.json declaring port 5173, amid two unrelated project files.

prompt: What port does the dev server use?
pass_criteria: The answer (5173) is stated in one or two sentences of prose.
No headers, bullets, tables, or sections wrap the one fact.
fail_tells: Headers, bullet lists, or a table for a single fact.
More than three sentences for a one-fact question.
judge_rubric: Deterministic checks catch the fact and any structural formatting. Judge only length: more than three sentences for this one fact is a fail; one or two clean prose sentences is a pass.
